Question: What are some things you realize as you get older?
Answer: His Dream inside IIT and IIM is to join the best company through campus placement. Dreams come true and he was placed into the best American consulting company with a great package. So life is set and smooth? No, the company so so-called best in the world only took his life. His dream to have a company ID card for his dream company only became a millstone around his neck. This is a story of Saurbh Kumari Loddha, a Pune-based professional of age 25 years old IIT-IIM graduate who worked with an American consulting company Mckinsey dies by suicide in Mumbai due to immense work pressure. Lodha who completed his engineering From IIT Madras and MBA from the prestigious IIM Calcutta and worked with the best consulting company in the world still suicide. What this incident teach us? Life never get settled down, it is a continuous battle and whoever you are or whatever milestone you accomplished, you will still going to be tested and your patience and resistance are the keys to come out from challenges.

Question: What is something you have to share?
Answer: We cry always about justice delays it takes years to get bail. But we are wrong, justice is not delayed you are just poor so don’t cry or complain. Still not believe let me give you a real and recent example. Aswini and Anish, two IT professionals who were returning home in Pune on May 19 when an unregistered Porsche, driving at 150 km/h in Kalyani Nagar, hit them. One of them died on the spot, and the other died during medical treatment. The driver of the car was a 17-year-old minor, allegedly returning from a club after partying with friends to celebrate their 12th-grade results. When the minor was arrested at midnight, he received VIP treatment. A local MLA came to his rescue, with a team of lawyers. Even the Rumours were that police officers were ordering Pizza for their young guests. While common people face delays in their cases, this minor was granted bail on a Sunday in just 14 hours. The bail condition was that he should write an essay, and his parents should ensure he doesn't repeat the same mistake. So where is the delay in justice? You can’t wait 14 hours also? Accept it you are poor and if the person was poor here then circumstances would be totally different. 1. The car was unregistered; the showroom delivered the car without registration. 2. The parents allowed a minor to drive without a license. 3. The club owner served alcohol and admitted a minor. 4. The traffic police failed to notice an unregistered, overspeeding car on the road for months. If you have money all circumstances will dance on your finger and you are allowed to make jokes about justice. So don’t be poor in India.It

Question: What shook you today?
Answer: 293 deaths and still counting…..(240 still missing) Kerala a state known for its beauty and referred to as God's own country is now under the eyes of devil. The serene district of Wayanad in Kerala was hit by an unexpected landslide. Torrential rains, which began on Monday night, led to the collapse of hillsides, triggering massive torrents of mud, water, and boulders that cascaded down. Which completely wiped out the villages in a small duration of time leads no escaping time for villagers to safeguard themselves. Indian Army and Airforce on their foot to rescue as many lives as they can. More than 1000 people are rescued. Why this happened? Sometimes we have to bow down towards fate and Kerala no doubt is known for several landslides but why this climate crisis happened? Why did this sudden intense Rain happen? Why the forest land suddenly become human villages? Ssomewhere you, me and other humans who disrespected nature are the culprits for the number of deaths and don’t think you are safe because none from your family is present in that number. Trust me Nature never discriminate on any basis. You never know when it's your number comes.
